tweets.text: A Coldcard hardware wallet bug led to 1,000+ BTC stolen — and AI was likely involved in the breach. Coinkite pushed a firmware fix, but experts say: move your funds first, update later. The era of AI-assisted hardware exploits is here.

Iran has been quietly collecting Bitcoin from ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz as a sanctions workaround. The U.S. just moved to shut it down after freezing Iran's other digital assets. Bitcoin as geopolitical insurance — until it isn't.

70 logical qubits. 2,415 two-qubit operations. 97 physical qubits. IBM and UChicago just posted a verified quantum-advantage run that finished in 15 minutes. Bitcoin's ECDSA isn't threatened today — but that gap keeps narrowing.
Coinbase's chief policy officer says younger Democrats actually understand the Clarity Act and want it passed. The generational divide on crypto regulation is becoming the real story on Capitol Hill.
